slides.title: Stop *one thing* first.
slides.sub: Before you start five new ones.

slides.title: Starting is the easy part.
slides.body: A new plan feels good on day one. Then it piles on top of everything that was already there.

slides.title: What keeps undoing it?
slides.body: Most of us already know the one habit that quietly cancels the rest. Look for that first.

slides.title: Make it small and clear.
slides.body: Not "stop being so negative." Something you'd catch: "Stop saying I'm fine when I'm not." "Stop replaying the argument at night."

slides.title: One for this month.
slides.body: Finish the sentence: "This month I'm stopping ___." Then notice what that habit was doing for you.
